pretreatment: chemically etched with a 5% aqueous HF solution, rinsed with deionized water, degassed at 800 °C, repeatedly annealed at 1250 °C
evidence: A boron-doped Si(001) wafer (resistivity 5 -12 ¿ cm; dimensions 5  20  0.8 mm3) was chemically etched with a 5% aqueous HF solution and rinsed with deionized water before it was loaded into the preparation chamber of the ESCALAB. The wafer was degassed at 800 °C for several hours and repeatedly annealed at 1250 °C by resistive heating to obtain a clean 21 surface.
